observations: Three photos show a white PlayStation 5 console with two controllers in front: one black and one white/cream.
The console has a glossy finish with a black horizontal line separating the top and bottom halves.
The controllers have the standard DualSense design with analog sticks, D-pad, and four-way button layout.
The background is a marble-patterned wall and a black leather surface.
No visible damage to the console or controllers in the photos.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in any photo.
No power cord or HDMI cable is shown.
No screen or display is shown to verify functionality.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
The controllers appear to be DualSense models, but no serial numbers or labels are visible to confirm they are original. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photos.
No games or game cases are visible in any photo. The FC26 package cannot be confirmed without seeing the games or their packaging.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original or have damaged buttons/ports
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the controller buttons, analog sticks, and ports, or a video showing them connecting to the console and functioning.

risks.risk: Games may not be included or may be pirated
risks.proof: Photos of the game cases or digital codes, or a video showing the games being installed and played.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number on the back of the console, or a video showing the console being powered on and displaying the system info screen.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the serial number.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Close-up photos of the controllers showing all buttons and ports.
Photos of the 10 games or digital codes for the FC26 package.
Photo of the console's system information screen showing model and serial number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
